title: UI风格#225 - Steampunk Industrial (蒸汽朋克)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Steampunk Industrial style When color palette Then features brass, copper, bronze metals
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#B5651D (黄铜), #8B4513 (铜棕), #2F4F4F (齿轮灰), #DAA520 (金黄)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Steampunk Industrial style When typography Then uses Victorian industrial:IM Fell, Rokkit, Special Elite
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：IM Fell (维多利亚), Rokkit (机械感), Special Elite (打字机)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Steampunk Industrial style When layout Then gear motifs, pipe elements, riveted panels
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：齿轮图案、管道元素、铆钉面板

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Steampunk Industrial style When UI elements Then clock mechanisms, steam effects, brass buttons
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：钟表机械、蒸汽效果、黄铜按钮

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Steampunk Industrial UI When functional Then includes gear chat, clock agents, steam stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：齿轮聊天、时钟代理、蒸汽统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Steampunk Industrial UI When copy Then uses steampunk: 'Gear', 'Steam', 'Clock', 'Pressure'
